en.title: AI cargo demand lifts EVA Air and China Airlines earnings as fuel costs climb
en.summary: Strong AI-driven cargo growth kept EVA Air and China Airlines earnings at high levels in the first nine months, while STARLUX Airlines fell into losses as fuel costs climbed.
body: Taiwan's two largest carriers held up in the first nine months of 2026 as strong AI-driven cargo demand offset rising fuel costs, while STARLUX Airlines slipped into losses. EVA Air and China Airlines both kept earnings at high levels in the third quarter and the first nine months; STARLUX, with cargo making up just over 10% of its revenue, was hit harder by fuel prices.

China Airlines posted NT$185.94 billion in consolidated revenue for the first nine months, with net profit attributable to the parent of NT$11.002 billion and earnings per share of NT$1.8, both records for the period; third-quarter revenue was NT$65.125 billion, net profit NT$4.42 billion and EPS NT$0.72. EVA Air reported third-quarter consolidated revenue of NT$66.094 billion, up 26%, net profit of NT$6.799 billion, up 15.7%, and EPS of NT$1.26; for the first nine months, revenue was NT$194.38 billion, up 19.5%, net profit NT$18.915 billion, up 2.3%, and EPS NT$3.5.

Cargo was the key earnings driver. EVA Air said air cargo benefited from sustained strong demand for AI servers and semiconductors, plus stocking demand for new consumer electronics, lifting both volumes and yields; cargo capacity rose 5.3% in the first nine months, tonnage 0.6% and cargo unit revenue 25.3%. Its third-quarter cargo revenue grew 34.5% and first-nine-months cargo revenue 27%, while the passenger load factor reached 81.5% over the first nine months.

October figures extended the momentum. China Airlines' October revenue was NT$22.156 billion, up 22.36% to a record for the month, with cargo revenue of NT$8.22 billion, up 48.05%, and passenger revenue of NT$12.001 billion, up 9.2%. EVA Air's October consolidated revenue reached NT$23.182 billion, up 22.63%, with passenger revenue of NT$13.536 billion, a record for the month, and cargo revenue of NT$6.869 billion, up 46.17%. STARLUX posted a third-quarter net loss of NT$293 million on revenue of NT$16.282 billion and a first-nine-months net loss of NT$638 million, as international oil prices ran 61% higher than a year earlier; its cargo revenue grew 45.2% to NT$5.19 billion in the first nine months but still accounted for only 11.6% of total revenue, carried mainly in passenger aircraft belly holds, with dedicated freighters to arrive from 2028.

facts.claim: EVA Air and China Airlines held earnings at high levels in the third quarter and the first nine months as AI-driven cargo growth offset fuel cost pressure, while STARLUX fell into losses.

China Airlines' first-nine-months revenue was NT$185.94 billion and net profit NT$11.002 billion with EPS of NT$1.8, both period records; third-quarter revenue was NT$65.125 billion, net profit NT$4.42 billion and EPS NT$0.72.

EVA Air's third-quarter revenue was NT$66.094 billion, up 26%, net profit NT$6.799 billion, up 15.7%, and EPS NT$1.26; first-nine-months revenue was NT$194.38 billion, up 19.5%, net profit NT$18.915 billion, up 2.3%, and EPS NT$3.5.
EVA Air said air cargo benefited from AI server and semiconductor demand and new consumer-electronics stocking; first-nine-months cargo capacity rose 5.3%, tonnage 0.6% and cargo unit revenue 25.3%.

China Airlines' October revenue was NT$22.156 billion, up 22.36%, with cargo revenue of NT$8.22 billion, up 48.05%, and passenger revenue of NT$12.001 billion, up 9.2%; EVA Air's October consolidated revenue was NT$23.182 billion, up 22.63%.

STARLUX posted a third-quarter net loss of NT$293 million and a first-nine-months net loss of NT$638 million as international oil prices ran 61% higher year on year; its cargo revenue grew 45.2% to NT$5.19 billion, 11.6% of total revenue, with freighters to arrive from 2028.

zh.title: AI貨運需求強，長榮航、華航前三季獲利持穩高檔
zh.summary: 受惠AI帶動貨運強勁成長，長榮航與華航前三季、第3季獲利持穩高檔；星宇航空受燃油成本拖累，前三季陷入虧損。
body: 全球航空業面臨燃油成本攀升壓力，但受惠人工智慧帶動貨運強勁成長，長榮航空與中華航空前三季、第3季獲利持穩高檔；星宇航空則受燃油成本與貨運營收占比僅一成多影響，第3季與前三季陷入虧損。
華航前三季合併營收新台幣1859.4億元，歸屬母公司淨利110.02億元，每股盈餘1.8元，營收及淨利雙創歷年同期新高；第3季營收651.25億元、淨利44.2億元，每股盈餘0.72元。長榮航空第3季合併營收660.94億元、年增26%，淨利67.99億元、年增15.7%，每股盈餘1.26元；前三季營收1943.8億元、年增19.5%，淨利189.15億元、年增2.3%，每股盈餘3.5元。
貨運是兩家業者獲利的關鍵動能。長榮航表示，航空貨運受益人工智慧伺服器及半導體需求持續強勁，加上消費性電子新機備貨需求顯現，貨運需求暢旺，推升貨量及運價；前9月貨運運能年增5.3%，載貨量年增0.6%，貨運單位收益年增25.3%。長榮航第3季貨運營收年增34.5%，前三季年增27%；前9月客運載客率達81.5%，旅客數增加9.2%，客運單位收益增5.6%。

10月數字延續動能。華航10月營收221.56億元、年增22.36%，創歷年同期新高，其中貨運收入82.2億元、年增48.05%，客運收入120.01億元、年增9.2%。長榮航10月合併營收231.82億元、年增22.63%，客運營收135.36億元創歷年同期新高，貨運營收68.69億元、年增46.17%。星宇航空第3季營收162.82億元、稅後淨損2.93億元，前三季淨損6.38億元；國際油價較去年同期上升61%，是獲利承壓的主因。星宇前三季貨運營收51.9億元、年增45.2%，但占整體營收僅11.6%，目前以客機腹艙載貨為主，2028年起將引進全貨機。
